title: Outer Wilds
blurb: A time-looping mystery about a tiny solar system that rewards curiosity over combat.
why: The best 'aha' moments of any game I've played — nothing else comes close.

title: Chicory: A Colorful Tale
blurb: A painting-powered adventure where you restore color to a world that's lost it.
why: The most emotionally honest game about creative self-doubt I've ever played.

title: Rain World
blurb: You're prey, not predator, in a brutal ecosystem sim dressed up as a platformer.
why: Unforgiving in a way that feels earned, not cheap.
